updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft introduced the SOC Identity Responder role to enable security operations center analysts to execute identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring multiple high-privilege roles. This least-privilege role reduces response delays and improves security posture by limiting administrative access to only what SOC teams need.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery is a built-in solution that automatically backs up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access policies, and authentication policies, enabling rapid recovery from accidental or malicious changes. The service is always on by default and provides point-in-time restoration capabilities without requiring manual configuration.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent user accounts with greater precision using Custom Security Attributes and Agent Risk policies. Admins can dynamically group agents and enforce compliance requirements, closing a critical security gap for organizations deploying autonomous AI workloads.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users not already in the directory to access packages using their email address, with automatic guest user provisioning and governance. This simplifies B2B onboarding workflows and extends Entra ID governance to external identities.

updates.title: AD Group Enforcement for Cloud Sync (Preview)
updates.summary: Entra Cloud Sync now supports AD group enforcement, preventing unauthorized changes to designated AD groups by blocking modifications made outside the Entra provisioning service. This capability prevents group drift and maintains consistency between Azure AD and on-premises Active Directory.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Domainless SAML federation allows external users to authenticate using IdP-managed credentials without requiring domain matching on email addresses. This simplifies B2B federation configuration and reduces administrative overhead for organizations supporting users across multiple email domains.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now generally available in the US Gov cloud, enabling standards-based user and group provisioning through the System for Cross-domain Identity Management specification. This provides government and compliance-sensitive organizations with modern identity lifecycle management capabilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Kerberos Key Rotation Improved Reliability
updates.summary: Kerberos key rotation reliability improved for environments using incoming trust referral flows by enhancing validation logic to attempt decryption with both primary and secondary keys. This reduces authentication failures during key rotation and improves hybrid environment stability.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Client Using Entra Registration
updates.summary: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) support for Windows Entra-registered devices is now generally available, allowing users to access corporate resources from personal devices with assigned Private Application traffic profiles. This expands remote work flexibility while maintaining security controls through Entra enrollment.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now blocks users on rooted or jailbroken devices from adding or using work or school accounts, enforcing device compliance by default. Users must migrate to compliant devices to continue using work accounts, strengthening mobile security posture.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Integration with Entra Global Secure Access (Preview)
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing restrictive actions and detecting risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. This prevents sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud applications including generative AI platforms and social media.

updates.title: File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP now supports automatic file quarantine that moves triggered files to a restricted, admin-controlled location and removes all user access while preserving files for investigation. This provides immediate containment of sensitive data exposure and prevents further sharing or misuse.

updates.title: DLP Restrictions for External Emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from external senders, mitigating data risks and prompt injection attacks from untrusted sources. This real-time control helps organizations maintain data security posture when using generative AI features.

updates.title: DLP Safeguards for Web Search in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from using sensitive data for external web searches, reducing data leakage and oversharing risks. This control applies real-time protections to AI-driven searches, ensuring sensitive information remains within organizational boundaries.

updates.title: DLP and Auto-labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This expands data protection and classification capabilities across the entire SaaS ecosystem.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Enrichment in Defender Graph API
updates.summary: DLP event data is now available via Graph API alongside Defender alert data, enabling easier correlation with SIEM tools, automated workflows, and customizable reporting. This integration simplifies data export and analysis for security teams managing compliance incidents.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP Policy Device Scoping
updates.summary: DLP policies now support dynamic device group scoping using Entra ID Custom Security Attributes, allowing organizations to enforce different policies based on device type and user role. For example, admins can require stricter controls for Finance users on Windows but allow looser policies on macOS.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience (Preview)
updates.summary: IRM now consolidates Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing investigators to view and manage both classic and AI-triaged alerts with expanded user profile signals from Entra ID. Enhanced note capabilities on alerts and cases improve collaboration during incident response.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Endpoint DLP Alert Analysis
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations now integrates with Endpoint DLP alerts, allowing investigators to launch DSI directly from DLP alerts and automatically gather related exfiltrated files for review. This accelerates analysis of endpoint data loss incidents and reduces investigation time.

updates.title: Information Protection Auto-labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and prepares data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.
